verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Advance's generative AI explicitly summarizes incidents and the Scribe Agent builds chronological incident narratives from Slack/incident data, directly matching 'AI writes the incident as it happens' and 'scribed call notes' (pagerduty-docs-23, pagerduty-docs-26, pagerduty-docs-38). However, the Scribe Agent is documented as tied to Post-Incident Reviews (after resolution) rather than clearly live/real-time during the call, and there's no explicit evidence of AI auto-drafting status-page updates in real time. Missing for 10: clear documentation that summaries/notes are generated live during an active incident (not just post-incident), and evidence of AI-drafted stakeholder updates during the incident itself.
